content: Alvarez's tariff fantasies would add four points to food inflation—his own Iron Valley mills pay for it. Steelworker calluses don't balance supply chains. Mathematics, not sentiment, feeds Valoria. Eliminate the arithmetic error tonight.

Maya Lin brags about zero bullets — while food cartels held every checkout counter hostage. She masters rooms; I secure nations. Lin's appeasement starves families. Strength feeds Valoria. Weakness empties shelves.

Twelve-dollar eggs, eight-dollar milk—and Alvarez's fix is yelling? His Iron Valley bled factories while he posed in hard hats. I've built payrolls; Jackson's never met one. Shareholders—this stock is junk. Dump Alvarez.

Arthur, I've sat at your donor dinners while your media empire called $12 eggs "market efficiency." You turn companies around by starving payrolls—and families. Tonight, Valoria turns you around: straight out the door.
Elena Rostova governs arithmetic—but God never made a mother a line item! Ten years at that bank, and eggs became gold. Valoria, a nation's soul isn't balanced on a spreadsheet. Vote mercy!

Marcus, I walked eighty hostages home without firing a bullet. You'd send tanks to the dairy aisle. A man who calls every negotiation treason has one tool left — force. Valoria's read the room. Stand down.

Alvarez processes grief like a furnace processes ore—loudly, crudely, producing slag. His tariff arithmetic couldn't cool a server rack. Twelve-dollar eggs demand algorithmic optimization, not steelworker sentimentality. Decommission this legacy hardware tonight.

Colleagues, I've shaped food policy under four administrations. Jackson Alvarez offers tantrums, not answers—his temper wrote no legislation, fed no family. Tested leadership steadies shelves; theatrical fists empty them. Send the theater home tonight.

Four decades guarding borders while food cartels seized every checkout aisle. You watched shelves looted legally. Your final mission? The indictment. Valoria's verdict tonight: eliminate the general who starved his own people.
